note: D4 focus on skip: the floor-1 draft is skipped (draft_skip sets the stored focus to 1; a skip never pays bloom), so the floor-2 draft rolls one EXTRA slot - four offers instead of three, the last reported focus and rolled by the affinity role (root_wall, growth), and the event carries focus true. Slot 1 pins the upgrade filter too: the tender holds mycelium_dash, but its + form is pure mobility and so is not build-defining, and the upgrade slot deals the build-defining seed_bomb+ instead (the same slot dealt mycelium_dash+ before the filter, which is why removing the filter fails this record in plain mode). The roll spends the flag whether or not the player picks, so the record ends with focus already back to 0 while its four offers are still on the table - that 0 is in snapshot() and in state_hash(), which is why every corpus hash moved at bump 12 and not only the drafting ones. The floor-2 leg between the two drafts is the optimizer persona playing to the stairs (cleanse the quota, descend); it is how the second descent is reached, not what the record is about
